name: MacGrann's Dried Meats
summary: Tundra MacGrann has a month's worth of salted meat set aside for winter in Dun Morogh. His provisions are locked in a thorium meat locker, but Old Icebeard has carried off the whole cache.

sections.title: A Winter Cache
sections.body: Tundra MacGrann prepared for winter by hunting game and salting the meat. He stored weeks of provisions in a sturdy chest, then locked it in a thorium meat locker to keep scavenging bears and prowling predators away from his homestead. Even so, he never expected an intruder strong enough to carry off the whole chest instead of trying to pry it open.

sections.title: Into the Yeti's Lair
sections.body: Old Icebeard raided MacGrann's camp while the dwarf was away tracking deer and dragged the heavy chest to his den in Chill Breeze Valley. The yeti cannot break through the solid thorium plating, but MacGrann's injured leg keeps him from mounting a swift rescue into the cavern. Without help retrieving the cache before winter sets in, the stranded hunter faces starvation in the mountain snows.

faq.answer: Tundra MacGrann salted and preserved a month's worth of provisions to carry him through the Dun Morogh winter.

faq.q: Why were the meats locked in a chest?
faq.answer: Dun Morogh's hungry predators, including mountain bears, might tear into the dried meat. MacGrann locked his winter supply in a reinforced thorium meat locker to keep them out.
Old Icebeard stole the whole locker while MacGrann was away hunting deer, then dragged it to his den in Chill Breeze Valley.

faq.q: Why can't Tundra MacGrann get his meats back himself?
faq.answer: MacGrann has an injured leg that keeps him from mounting a swift rescue into the cavern.

angles.text: As a cook, you can salt and cure game to preserve meat through Dun Morogh's freezing cold. Hunters like MacGrann rely on it to keep food for the winter.
As a dwarf, you know that preparation means survival in the high peaks. Losing a winter cache can mean the difference between life and death.
